answer: Agents jump-start a knoll-mounted whisper that echoes across the delta at 1.2kt/s; any twin whispers collide and silence the relay in 8.4ms. A Sybil shouts louder, yet each shout forces a 8.4ms wait plus capacitor drain—farms can’t stack relays faster than sound, so every fake costs 8.4ms and a drained capacitor no bulk market sells.
